The '''kirruk''' was a [[Reptile/Legends|reptilian]] native to [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]]. Quadrupeds, that moved about on powerful, four-clawed limbs, kirruk were domesticated by the [[Ysanna/Legends|Ysanna]] following the planet's ruin during the [[Cron Supernova/Legends|Cron Supernova]]. They were named for their squawking call, and served as mounts for their Ysanna masters.
